[NDBG.2.1] Working-memory inspection — counts, the per-fact accessors, and the
`ds_engine_for_each_fact` visitor — is specified in
[NFCT.6]. `ds_engine_mem` additionally returns a
byte-level breakdown of the Rete structures (`ds_engine_mem_t`); it returns
`DS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED` on a non-Rete engine.

Its counts of facts, network nodes, alpha matches and beta tokens describe the
program's logical state, and two conforming runtimes report the same counts for
the same program and inputs. `wm_fact_count` counts every fact in working memory,
the ones the lowering and the engine make included, so it can exceed
`ds_engine_fact_count` ([NFCT.6.3]). Its byte sizes and its intern fields
(`intern_count`, `intern_string_bytes`) describe a runtime's own storage and are
implementation-defined, as the `ds.intern.*` gauges are ([NMET.4.7]): a runtime
reports its own, and reports `0` for storage it does not keep. `total_bytes` is
the sum of the byte fields it reports.
